page_title: BAY 4-0 EIN | Bayern Munich v Eintracht Frankfurt 23/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' 4 - 0 Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
90+2' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the corner with a short pass.

90+1' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Kevin Trapp is equal to it and makes an easy save. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
90' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
89' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
85' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Jamal Musiala and he is replaced by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
85' Substitution. Michael Olise makes his way off the pitch and Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) comes on as his replacement.
83' 3 - 0 Goal! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
80' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
78' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
77' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) duly receives a yellow card.
75' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Hugo Ekitike.
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) coming on for Ansgar Knauff.
75' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
74' The ball is laid off to Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Kevin Trapp to make a decent save.
69' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
69' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough foul. Sascha Stegemann stops the game and makes a call.

68' That's unlucky! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
64' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Thomas Muller is replaced by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich).
63' Here is a change. Hiroki Ito is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich).
62' That will be all from Jean-Matteo Bahoya who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
61' 2 - 0 Goal! Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
61' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) will take the corner.
58' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
57' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is penalised for holding. Sascha Stegemann signals a set piece.
54' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) makes a strong challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.
53' The corner kick from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

53' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes contact with a cross but fails to connect perfectly. The ball heads right towards the middle of the goal where the goalkeeper makes a decent save to deny him.

51' That was a nice football moment. Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Kevin Trapp guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
49' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replaced by Ellyes Skhiri.
46' Dino Toppmoller makes a half-time substitution. Elye Wahi comes on in place of Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' Sascha Stegemann has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

45+5' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Manuel Neuer anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Eintracht Frankfurt are going to take it.
45+4' It looks like Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) saw red with that tackle. Sascha Stegemann won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45+3' 1 - 0 Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
45+1' The resulting corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
43' Joshua Kimmich is being substituted because of an injury. Vincent Kompany sends Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) on the pitch.
42' Looks like Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

40' What a sweet touch by Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him!
36' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
33' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich).
30' Half-chance! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a pass into the box, but Manuel Neuer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
27' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
26' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
25' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the roof of the net, but Kevin Trapp is equal to it and makes an easy save.
24' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
24' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

22' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
22' The ball is crossed into the box and Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp gets a glove on it to thwart him.
17' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Kevin Trapp comes off his line to gather the ball.
16' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
13' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
9' Great chance! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies a whisker wide of the right post.
8' The Bayern Munich players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' What a big chance! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
6' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
2' The ball is cleared after Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Bayern Munich will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Sascha Stegemann.
